AuthenticationServiceClient
Client of the AuthenticationService of the gRPC module: exchanges user and password for an Alfresco ticket, gRPC only, no REST.
BulkExporter
Exports the content of a repository folder in the layout read by the Alfresco Bulk Filesystem Import Tool: one file or directory per document or folder, named as in Alfresco; next to each one a <name>.metadata.properties.xml shadow file (Java XML properties) with type, aspects and the properties, names in prefix:local form; the previous versions of a document as <name>.v1, <name>.v2, ... oldest first, with their shadow files <name>.metadata.properties.xml.v1, ...: the file without suffix is the current version.
BulkExporter.Progress
Counters and errors of an export.
ExampleApplication
PoC of protoalf-client, gRPC only: logs in through AuthenticationService, lists the children of Company Home (-root-), then the 10 documents modified most recently, and exits.
ExportTools
Exports of repository folders in the Bulk Filesystem Import layout, as MCP tools.
GrpcAuthenticationService
Exchanges user and password for an Alfresco ticket.
GrpcContentService
Adapts Alfresco ContentService using content slices, byte writes and streaming rather than local reader/writer handles.
GrpcDictionaryService
Adapts Alfresco DictionaryService model lookups and listings with optional property expansion.
GrpcFileFolderService
Adapts Alfresco FileFolderService list, create, move and copy operations.
GrpcNodeService
Adapts Alfresco NodeService operations; getNode and updateNode are aggregate convenience extensions.
GrpcSearchService
Adapts Alfresco SearchService.query with query language, pagination and ordered sort parameters.
GrpcServer
 
GrpcVersionService
Adapts Alfresco VersionService.getVersionHistory, including frozen node metadata.
NodeServiceClient
Thin wrapper around the generated gRPC stub: attaches the Alfresco ticket to every call and retries once with a fresh ticket when the server answers UNAUTHENTICATED (expired ticket).
TicketInterceptor
Validates tickets without leaving Alfresco's thread-local authentication behind.
TicketProvider
Supplies the Alfresco authentication ticket sent to the gRPC module in the alfresco-ticket header: every call runs as the user the ticket belongs to.
